verdict.rationale: Mem0's entity-scoped memory separates memories by user, agent, app and session, which supports keeping private memory private. Scoping at the app level implies memory could be shared across agents or users within an app, but the evidence never explicitly documents selective sharing or group/team memory. missing for 10: explicit documentation of shared team/group memory spaces, selective promotion of memories from private to shared scope, permission controls over who can read shared memory, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share selected memory across multiple agents or users (team or group memory) while keeping private memory private

citations.quote: Mem0's Platform API lets you separate memories for different users, agents, and apps.
Scope conversations by user, agent, app, and session so memories land exactly where they belong.
